test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_exclusion_search (a UInt8, b UInt64, c UInt64, s String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (a, b) SETTINGS index_granularity = 64
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_exclusion_search SELECT number % 4, intDiv(number, 4), number, toString(number) FROM numbers_mt(50000000)
test.query: SELECT * FROM t_exclusion_search WHERE b BETWEEN 1000000 AND 11000000 LIMIT 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT * FROM t_exclusion_search WHERE b BETWEEN 1000000 AND 11000000 AND c % 7 = 1 LIMIT 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT * FROM t_exclusion_search WHERE b BETWEEN 1000000 AND 11000000 AND NOT startsWith(s, '1') LIMIT 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT * FROM t_exclusion_search WHERE (b < 2000000 OR c % 7 = 1) AND b BETWEEN 1000000 AND 11000000 LIMIT 1 FORMAT Null
